stem: Which sanitation plan is strongest for a tool shared between rooms?
choices: Use the room-specific or approved shared-tool process, including cleaning/disinfection at the defined transition points
Wipe the tool only when visible residue appears
Sanitize it once at the beginning of the week
Rinse it with irrigation water between rooms
rationale: A controlled shared-tool process addresses contamination at the points where movement can connect zones; visible residue alone is not a reliable indicator of risk.
